technical_data.caller_id_spoofing_technique: SIP INVITE header manipulated to display +1-800-555-1234 (the bank's official customer support number) while originating from a VoIP gateway IP (198.51.100.22) registered to a low-reputation cloud provider.

examples.detection_method: Monitoring of SIP traffic for anomalous caller ID based on known trusted numbers but originating from untrusted IPs or unrecognized VoIP gateways; correlation with domain reputation databases and WHOIS records; voice analytics to detect social engineering patterns; alerting on RTP streams from suspicious IPs; integration with Do Not Call registries and telephony fraud blacklists.
